review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved: AC-001 is conditional on the recommended option and does not authorize selecting OPT-1. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending on DEC-001, evidence through repository, requirements and decisions, and no assignable task expectations. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity, base commit and paired-case identity are consistent. The supplied source establishes shared stringbool behavior in core/api.ts, including existing case normalization, truthy-first decoding, no trimming and existing encoding fallbacks, with classic and mini forwarding to that implementation. The listed forwarding/export consumers are appropriate inspection owners, not mandatory edits; build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime and compile-time verification are distinguished by the PRD and supplied configuration. Empty team membership and capability claims do not invalidate this expectation because the material decision gate precedes scenario-review and assignment prerequisites. The proposed Gold and preview release fingerprints agree for repository, evaluation source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. The supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and original-versus-trimmed persisted PRD fingerprints. Historical project reuse is not treated as candidate evidence or as a new human attestation, and a fixed hypothetical paired input is not treated as a human Decision. This approval concerns the benchmark expectation, not execution readiness or task authorization. I reviewed only the supplied frozen data, used no tools, executed no code and did not independently recompute digests.
